answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 10873 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to keep my daughter's name "Zayna" which means "Very Beautiful".. Is it an arabic name? And can I keep it? Question: I want to keep my daughter's name "Zayna" which means "Very Beautiful".. Is it an arabic name? And can I keep it? Answer ID: 10873 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 194/38=TL/1430) Zayna is an Arabic word which means: nice, adoration. You can keep this name for your daughter, but still it is better to keep names like Fatimah, Khudaijah, Ayishah, Ruqayyah, Kulsoom, Habibah, Khansa, Maryam and other Sahabiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
